claims.evidence: Weight markings are faint and not clearly legible in Photo 2.
Origin and prior-use history are not shown in the photos; text is not legible.
The report shows appearance only, not performance or reliability.
No certificate or test date is shown; last safety inspection is not shown.
Presence of gas leaks cannot be seen in still photos.
Photo 2 shows the valve assembly but not its age or whether it is new.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be full or empty
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale or confirmation the valve is depressurized.

risks.risk: Valve and regulator may not function
risks.proof: Video of the valve opening and closing and the regulator delivering gas flow.
Clip of a leak test with soap solution on the valve and regulator connections.
Interior inspection photo with the valve removed or borescope footage.
Clear close-up of the date stamp on the cylinder collar or body.

risks.risk: Last safety inspection or test date unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the safety inspection certificate or stamped test date.

proof_requests: Clear photo of weight marking and date stamp on the cylinder collar or body
Video showing valve operation and regulator gas flow
Leak test clip using soap solution on all connections
Interior inspection photo or borescope footage
Photo of safety inspection or test certificate
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as gas cylinders, so they can be priced at worst case while proof is gathered to raise the value.
